item.title: House amendment responding to Pentagon-Anthropic conflict fails committee vote
item.description: Lawmakers split over an amendment to the Defense Production Act from Rep. Sam Liccardo, D-Calif., that would have prohibited the government from blacklisting firms opposed to their tech being used in certain situations.

item.title: IRS CEO largely dodges questions about data sharing at IRS, SSA
item.description: Frank Bisignano cited “current litigation” for why he could not provide further details about IRS data sharing with ICE, and he disputed court records detailing how DOGE employees handled data at SSA.

item.title: Trump’s CISA nominee said he left Coast Guard to address GOP hold
item.description: Sean Plankey confirmed the intent to Nextgov/FCW and said he’s “prepared to lead the nation’s cyber defense agency to protect the federal civilian networks and our nation’s critical infrastructure from physical and cyber attacks.”

item.title: VA is increasingly looking to AI to enhance claims processing
item.description: The department is planning to broaden its machine learning-powered Automated Decision Support tool to cover more types of claims.

item.title: SBA boots 628 more companies from 8(a) program
item.description: Total termination actions now represent 18% of the small business contracting program as the Trump administration's crackdown continues.

item.title: Trump to fire DHS Secretary Noem, selects Mullin as successor
item.description: The controversial Homeland Security leader will end her tenure amid a budget shutdown of her agency and following bipartisan criticism in both houses of Congress.

item.title: NIST director nominee commits to support AI standards-setting, manufacturing
item.description: Arvind Raman told lawmakers that it is “vitally important” that the U.S. lead in global standards-setting so that the country’s values are entrenched in AI development.

item.title: DOD names James “Aaron” Bishop to serve as CISO
item.description: Bishop previously served as CISO for the Air Force and as the CISO and VP at Science Applications International Corporation before that.

item.title: FBI is probing ‘suspicious’ breach into bureau networks
item.description: Initial reporting tied the incident to the FBI’s wiretap systems, which are used to lawfully surveil suspected criminals and spies.

item.title: Private sector, former military leaders urge Congress intervene in Pentagon-Anthropic dispute
item.description: Over 30 former military officers and individuals working in tech sent a letter to congressional leadership expressing concern over the Pentagon-Anthropic dispute and asking for lawmakers to take action to reign in executive power and set AI guardrails.
